text:
meg: Design brief 10am PT launch next Wed. Need a compact asset set by Tue EOD: 1) benchmark one-pager hero (1200x600) with swap-able headlines and a small sparkline panel, 2) webinar signup modal (480x320) that auto-populates source tags for inbound routing, 3) three-panel social carousel (1080x1080) and a 9:16 short clip (15s). Keep strictly on-brand and accessible. cc @oliver @sara

oliver: Got it. Can you confirm primary + alt headlines and whether JP/FR localization is required? Also share the Figma link.

meg: Primary: "Predictable inference for production". Alt: "Lower unit cost, consistent latency". Localization: JP yes, FR optional (defer to content). Figma: https://figma.com/file/launch_onepager_xyz

sara: Design question: do we want the sparkline to animate in the short clip only, or also show a still on the hero?

oliver: Show a static abstract sparkline on hero with caption: "Representative benchmark across standard GPUs"; animate only in the 9:16 clip. No raw numbers, no chip/vendor names.

nate: Inbound routing note: modal should include hidden fields: utm_campaign, utm_source, utm_variant and a webinar_id param so Sales ops can route leads. Example: ?webinar_id=2026-05-12. Can design put a small help text in the modal copy describing what will be captured?

meg: Yes include a tiny line: "We'll capture event details to help Sales route your request." Keep it minimal.

elline: Legalbot: avoid absolute % claims or superlatives. Use words like "lower" or "reduced". I'll review final copy; please don't mention chip models.

figmabot: Frames created: onepager_hero_v2 (1200x600), modal_signup_compact_v1 (480x320), social_carousel_v1 (1080x1080 x3), short_clip_v1 (1080x1920). Link: https://figma.com/frame/onepager-frames-abc

oliver: I'll drop hero + modal drafts by Fri EOD. For hero, I'll keep headline in a swap-friendly auto-layout so copy tests don't reflow. CTA uses Inter 600. CTA color token? @meg

meg: CTA token is #FF3B30 (brand). Please include an accessible high-contrast variant and export swatches. Motion token: short spring for clip.

figmabot: Brand token note: CTA #FF3B30, body Inter 400, CTA Inter 600. Contrast variant requested.

sara: For analytics provide two UTMs for the headline test so we can split traffic: variant A (latency-first) and variant B (cost-first). Also add utm_content for creative format.

nate: Suggested UTMs: variant A: utm_campaign=onepager_may2026&utm_source=social&utm_variant=latency_first&utm_content=hero; variant B: utm_campaign=onepager_may2026&utm_source=social&utm_variant=cost_first&utm_content=hero. Webinar param: webinar_id=2026-05-12.

oliver: GIF/clip note: animate the sparkline and a subtle CTA pulse. Keep mp4 export and gif fallback; target web size <2MB for GIF fallback if possible. Loop with ease-in.

meg: Accessibility: CTA must meet 4.5:1 on hero. If using imagery, apply a 24% dark overlay. Include alt text for all images and a concise motion description for the clip.

elline: I'll review copy Monday morning. Please upload early drafts so we can iterate.

oliver: Plan: upload hero+modal drafts Fri EOD, social carousel + clip rough Monday AM, copy/legal review Monday afternoon, final exports Tue EOD. Ping here when each upload is done.

sara: Also ask localization: JP headline may be longer  allow extra vertical space and scalable type. FR if needed will be a follow-up.

meg: Thank you team. Final checklist for handoff: figma frames, export checklist (png @2x for hero, web-optimized JPG for carousel, mp4 + gif), alt text file, and a tiny CSV with utm strings for engineers.

oliver: Will add export checklist to figma and drop CSV in the drive. Comment thread link: https://figma.com/comments/onepager-xyz

meg: :thumbsup: Closing timeline  mock drafts Fri, review Mon, final Tue EOD PT.
